name: ATS 2027 International Conference
description: The ATS International Conference is the American Thoracic Society's annual meeting on pulmonary, critical care, and sleep medicine research. The 2027 conference is scheduled for New Orleans, Louisiana.

sources.note: Official conference landing page confirming ATS 2027 dates, New Orleans location, and both submission deadlines
